findings.problem: Required Q01 mixed, Q02 partially live and Q22 small-boundary profiles have no accepting physical contract.
findings.change: Add focused frame-fold removal, accumulator-width and paired strategy-preservation contracts. No cases are removed and parsing alone cannot satisfy the new checks.

findings.problem: SUM negative controls can bypass paired structure preservation; a Q29 positive can fail to improve while another positive promotes the batch.
findings.change: Require paired callable-shape equality for SUM controls and a strict positive comparison-node decrease for each Q29 positive case.

case_contracts.contract: Use the existing nonempty frame-collector, zero Fold/Fold1 and boundary-access assertions; the profile combines COUNT with supported machine-integer SUM. The independent semantic oracle still checks every result.
case_contracts.quality_limit: This is structural optimization evidence. It does not establish memory/latency/work scaling; OA05 remains separate.

case_contracts.contract: Keep a real frame pipeline and exactly one retained optional-COUNT accumulator, with exact init/update field binding and a WinFrame queue shared with exactly one collector. Require a wider matching baseline state. A Fold1 count decrease is not required because all functions share one fold.
case_contracts.quality_limit: Unresolved local lets, lambda block bodies, nonidentity frame maps, unknown fold inputs or queue bindings fail closed. Actual baseline/fixed AST observation is required before claiming this case has passed.

case_contracts.contract: Require lowered SqlIn and a positive explicitly counted binary equality metric; pair against equal baseline equality counts and identical callable counts.
case_contracts.quality_limit: Do not assume exact equality count five for nullable variants and do not require global Contains zero. These checks preserve the observed small-boundary strategy, not a per-row evaluation-count proof.

case_contracts.contract: All SUM _control cases except the native positive require parsed baseline/fixed plans, the existing control assertion and identical nonempty typed callable maps.
case_contracts.quality_limit: The native mixed-function positive remains on its existing optimization path. Structural preservation is separate from measured resource acceptance.

case_contracts.contract: Each positive separately requires integer comparison-node counters with baseline > fixed > 0, followed by its existing physical-target assertions.
case_contracts.quality_limit: This is expression DAG reduction, not a runtime evaluation-frequency claim. Existing evaluation_count_verified=false is preserved.

parser_scope.q02_reader: Only concrete nodes returned by existing parse_physical_graph are accepted; unresolved locals are not treated as matching placeholders.
parser_scope.q22_counter: Binary unquoted == heads are counted explicitly because the generic callable regex excludes operator symbols.

layering.later: OA05 resource gate follows this pairing snapshot; OA10 remains a separate driver patch.

source_contracts.contract: COUNT and machine-integer SUM take prefix-boundary paths; the general Fold1 is referenced only by functions that remain on the fallback path.
Only live function definitions retain their arguments; partition/order dependencies remain when any function is live.
WindowFuncs.RetainKeys removes dead function definitions and resets cached output IUs.

Prepare enumerates retained functions. BuildFoldLambda emits an accumulator field for each function; optional COUNT uses AggrCountInit/AggrCountUpdate. One general Fold1 consumes WinFrame backed by the same QueueCreate as WinFramesCollector.

Focused small explicit collection lowering emits scalar equality comparisons; the additional large-collection peephole path activates only for size greater than five. Nullable forms wrap comparisons, so exact equality counts are observed rather than invented.
The new NeedsRboLargeSqlInLowering gate invokes the existing physical peephole path only for qualifying large collections.
Only matching total primitive comparisons are removed from fetched-row residuals; arithmetic/guard/other controls retain their original expression structure.

minimal_actual_evidence_needed: For Q02, one baseline and one fixed anonymous observation of the unchanged q02_partial profile: capture only descriptor completeness, state widths, optional-count binding and queue association. If lexical locals prevent resolution, retain pending and review a separately scoped lexical adapter rather than relaxing checks.

For Q22, preserve all eight size-five combinations of ANSI/legacy, tuple/list and nullable/required. Obtain paired equality and callable counters with semantic oracles; do not infer nullable shapes from source alone.

For Q01, observe the mixed profile and all SUM negative controls against the same fixed/base workload and profile hashes. Require the existing direct/runtime prerequisites and the separate resource gate for full quality acceptance.

For Q29, obtain actual paired evidence for both primitive and optional positives; one positive cannot compensate for the other. Preserve unsafe-control pair checks supplied by the preceding admission patch.
review_amendments: The independent reviewer identified that Python dict equality accepts Boolean/float counters equal to integer counters. The paired unchanged-shape predicate now checks exact nonnegative integer types on both baseline and fixed maps.
